verdict.rationale: Viam is a robotics and machine-management platform that AI agents operate through its CLI and SDKs (viam-docs-12); it is not itself an AI agent or LLM host that consumes tools. Plugging MCP servers in as a tool client is therefore a category mismatch. The evidence also never shows Viam acting as an MCP client, so the exception that would make the axis apply is not triggered.
